study type: Secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. Cesarean) at periviability
outcome: Bayley II scores (mental and motor) at 2 years of age
cohort: This study included 158 infants born between 23 4/7 and 25 6/7 weeks gestation.
finding: There was no difference in Bayley II scores at 2 years of age between infants delivered vaginally and those delivered by Cesarean section at periviability.
mod_finding: There was no difference in Bayley II scores at 2 years of age between infants delivered vaginally and those delivered by Cesarean section at periviability.
